Jesus walks on the water, Matthew 14. A storm at night, disciples afraid, a figure on the waves. Peter said, if it is you, call me, and for a while he walked to Jesus, then he looked at the wind, he sank, and Jesus caught him, saying, o thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt. The lesson is not only a trick with waves—it is the eyes. Keep your eyes on Christ when fear gets loud, and if you sink, call His name, He is already near enough to lift you.
